Scan item QR code

Start the camera or choose a QR image. Images are processed on this device.

Import Inventory from SAP

Upload the full SAP list as Excel (.xlsx / .xls) or CSV. Items match by item number. Existing physical QTY and Stock In/Out history are always preserved. The inventory format is: #, Item No., Item Description, QTY, UoM. Items missing from the file are kept.

Use a worksheet with column headers in its first row. Map your SAP columns below.

Use the time of the FIRST import that created zero balances. The latest import time is suggested when available; correct it if you imported the list again. Only movements recorded after this time are added/subtracted. Existing balances must reconcile before correction is allowed.

Select a file to preview it before importing.

Import Stock In

Choose an Excel (.xlsx / .xls) or CSV list. Items must already exist in Inventory. Dates can be Excel dates, YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YY (day-month-year). Decimal quantities such as 0.0125 are supported. Every row is a separate movement, even when the same item, date and quantity repeat. Uploading the same file again adds all its rows again. Existing movements are not edited.

First row must contain column headers. Match your file columns below.

Select a file to preview movements.

Backup / Restore

A full backup contains inventory, physical quantities, Stock In/Out history and import/correction records. Keep this file private.

Import SAP Goods Issue completion

Upload only items successfully issued in SAP. This updates existing Stock Out SAP status only. It never creates a Stock Out entry or changes physical stock. Match by Item No., Department and UOM; confirm which entry received each issued quantity.

For a future, separate Goods Issue with identical rows, enter its distinct SAP document number. Without a document number, an identical completion list is treated as the same batch.

Select your SAP export to preview matches.

Install GIGROUP App

Use the same CRM address and sign in with your company account on each device. An internet connection is required to load and save company records.
